part2_tkinter module

Part 2: GUI with Tkinter - School Management System.

Forms to add students, instructors and courses, course registration and instructor assignment through dropdowns, a Treeview showing all records, search, edit/delete and save/load to a JSON file.

class part2_tkinter.SchoolManagementApp(root)[source]

Bases: object

Manage students, instructors and courses through a Tkinter interface.

Parameters:

root (tkinter.Tk) – Main window used to display the application.

Variables:

  • root (tkinter.Tk) – Application window.

  • students (list[part1_oop.Student]) – Current student records.

  • instructors (list[part1_oop.Instructor]) – Current instructor records.

  • courses (list[part1_oop.Course]) – Current course records.

static matches(query, name, record_id, courses)[source]

Check whether a record contains the search text.

Parameters:

  • query (str) – Lowercase search text; an empty string matches all records.

  • name (str) – Student, instructor or course name.

  • record_id (str) – Record ID.

  • courses (str) – Course text to search.

Returns:

True if the query occurs in any searched field, otherwise False.

bool
